newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's net reserves grew $17 mln in August.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's net reserves grew $17 mln in August.

text.p: Ecuador's international reserves grew in August by 1.12 percent or $17 million to $1.526 billion, a government official said Tuesday.
Reserves were $1.509 billion in July and $1.659 billion in August 1995.
The official, who requested anonymity, said the reserves grew from the central bank's intervention in the foreign exchange market. It bought $60.3 million in August.
Reserves stood at $1.557 billion at the end of last year, down $145 million from the end of 1994.
